title: Labby Code Mode Retained Result Marker
description: The JSON truncation marker emitted by `truncate_execution_response` when a Code Mode final result exceeds the response envelope budget. Fields `truncated`, `original_size`, `original_tokens`, `preview`, `artifacts`, and `next_action` are the pre-existing shape (labby-codemode/src/truncate.rs::truncation_marker); `result_handle` and `retained_until` are additive and present ONLY when the value was admitted to the retained-result store.

original_size.description: Serialized byte length of the pre-truncation result.

preview.description: UTF-8-boundary-safe prefix of the serialized result, capped at 1024 bytes.

artifacts.description: Artifact receipts carried through unchanged from the execution response.

next_action.description: Model-facing guidance, and self-contained: when `result_handle` is present this text names that field explicitly, so a caller reading only `next_action` can act. Reduce-before-return remains the leading instruction; paging is mentioned second and qualified to expensive or rate-limited calls.

retained_until.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant after which the handle is guaranteed unusable. Fixed at creation; never extended by access.

retained_bytes.description: Serialized byte length actually retained. Equals `original_size` in v1.

handle.description: Opaque retained-result handle: the literal prefix `cmr_` followed by 32 lowercase hex characters (UUID v4, hyphens stripped). Carries no encoded ownership, path, or secret material — it is an unguessable lookup key only.
